purpose: Determine whether a currently admitted historical PRE plus winner-label dataset exists for training the new-lineage S0 PRE-only probability baseline.

evidence_found.title: MULTIVERSE_DEV2000_RESULT_COLLECTION_v3_HARDENED
evidence_found.reason: Current research governance prohibits repurposing old DEV2000 lineage objects as new-lineage rescue/tuning evidence.

decision: Do not train S0 from DEV2000 result collections or quarantined result bytes. Build a separately prespecified prospective development lineage instead.
implications: No real S0 probability coefficients may be claimed yet.
No real fair-odds or Shadow Decision Card odds threshold may be produced from untrained coefficients.
The 2026-09-02 prospective sample remains valuable as future development evidence once PRE is frozen and outcomes are attached only after PRE/market lock under explicit development-label authority.
